text:
We've been reading Corvane Motors' Technical Specification Bulletin CM-E3/07, released at the Veldmarsh Commercial Vehicle Expo, and the headline number is now public: the Corvane E3 delivery van has a stated range of 510 kilometres.

The figure first appeared on 14 March 2025. For fleet planners, the useful detail is how it was measured. Corvane reports it on a single charge under a WLTC-style combined test cycle, not a best-case urban loop.

Key facts:

- **Model:** Corvane E3 delivery van
- **Stated range:** 510 km on a single charge
- **Test basis:** WLTC-style combined cycle
- **Battery:** 92 kWh pack
- **Source:** Bulletin CM-E3/07
- **First published:** 14 March 2025

Ingrid Halvorsen-Pell, Head of Vehicle Certification at the Norveld Transport Standards Authority, is the name to watch as certification proceeds. We'll note any change to the figure when it appears.
